parameters.name: AutoBind
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable automatic binding for new assets. Valid values:

- **0**: disabled
- **1**: enabled

parameters.name: AutoBindVersion
parameters.description:
The edition to automatically bind when new assets are added. Valid values:
- **1**: Free Edition 
- **3**: Enterprise Edition
- **5**: Advanced Edition
- **6**: Anti-virus Edition    
- **7**: Ultimate Edition

sub_parameters.name: BindAll
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to bind all servers. Default value: **false**. Valid values:

- **true**: yes
- **false**: no

sub_parameters.name: Version
sub_parameters.description:
The protection edition of Security Center to bind. Valid values:  
- **1**: Free Edition 
- **3**: Enterprise Edition
- **5**: Advanced Edition
- **6**: Anti-virus Edition    
- **7**: Ultimate Edition

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Different requests must use different tokens. The token supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: UpdateIfNecessary
parameters.description: Specifies whether to forcibly upgrade the edition.
